ITEM 1 | Single wedge-shaped piece with a rectangular-triangular outline, roughly 9 cm long and 5 cm wide at its widest, lying in the upper-left area of a large square white plate; golden-orange top with browned spots, scattered melted pale yellow-white cheese patches over a reddish-orange tomato-colored sauce layer, slightly glossy where oily, soft and flexible-looking, bread-like base edge visible at the lower-right of the piece, sitting alone with no other food touching it | 70

ITEM 2 | Reddish-orange tomato sauce visible as a thin, glossy layer beneath and between the cheese patches on the same piece, with some spots of deeper red where it pooled; spread across roughly 30 percent of the piece's top surface, very thin (under 2 mm), moist and slightly sheeny | 8

ITEM 3 | Melted pale white-yellow cheese, soft and stretchy-looking, in irregular blobs and streaks across the top of the same piece, with slight golden browning at the edges of the blobs, covering roughly 40 percent of the piece's top surface, about 1 cm thick at the thickest patches | 15
